name: 21st.dev
what: Community catalog of React and shadcn components, themes (token CSS) and templates, with preview images and clips. Also Remotion video blocks with a hosted video editor, a brand logo lookup, and handoff of designs the user generated on 21st.
install: Attach the 21st.dev connector in the host's connector settings, or register the remote MCP server https://21st.dev/api/mcp with a bearer token read from the environment variable API_KEY_21ST.
evidenceNote: Live successful calls: search (components, themes, templates), get_inspiration, get_theme, get_usage, video_list_blocks, list_teams, list_bookmark_lists. NOT exercised: get_component (metered source retrieval), every video project, snapshot and export call, take handoff. search_logo ran and returned empty results.
